lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity white circular clusters arranged in a semi-ordered grid posterior to the gill slits; primary horizontal row at mid-flank exhibits five distinct maxima aligned with vertical stripe intervals.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical bands of elevated luminance intersect with horizontal axes of blobs, forming fixed grid nodes; highest contrast intersections are located in the region between the fifth gill slit and the leading edge of the dorsal fin.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear ridges running parallel across the upper flank; top-most ridge shows a sharp luminance transition with high-intensity highlights on the dorsal surface and deep shadow on the ventral surface.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of small, low-intensity spots localized primarily at the base and the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced caustic network pattern caused by surface light refraction overlaying the anatomical pigmentation; presence of an Echeneidae specimen attached to the base of the left pectoral fin.
